title: the release VEX from the waivers, every waiver with an owner and a date (plan 10 row 10G-8)
note: lane H's card 10G-8 (D-1339); the waivers are the vulnerability and os_packages_unreadable entries of deploy/supply-chain-allowlist.yaml

findings.claim: none of the 63 vulnerability waivers of the allow-list recorded the date it was accepted
a waiver without an owner or a date passed every check: owner was optional and there was no date key
the signed release bundle carries no VEX; adding it to the SBOM extras of tools/release.py changes what the rc1 bundle build requires, so it waits for after rc1
the 49 per-id HAPI FHIR and vLLM waivers carry D-340's date 2026-11-10; the ledger says some findings were published 2026-11-11 under the same rule and does not say which
54 of the 62 VEX records say exploitable (response update) because only the 8 Authelia reasons record a not-reachable analysis; the security owner may record more
the package-wide linux-libc-dev waiver (D-622) names no ids, so its VEX record has id * which no scanner matches; the ids could come from the release's gate record
the 23 licence entries, 10 licence budgets and 57 security-scan ignores have no owner or date (the ignores no review date) and are outside the waiver check

for the integrator and the owner to rule: whether the waivers of this public allow-list, the release VEX made from them and known-image-findings.md should name a role as owner in place of a person (D-1004 wrote the owner's name in each entry); not decided here
the release VEX is not validated against the CycloneDX 1.6 JSON schema: no schema in the tree and no network call
